result.instructions: Tools for ShipsGo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Where is our ocean container MSCU1234567 right now?"; "List all ocean shipments that are still sailing, with their carriers."; "Start tracking booking MEDUQY000000 with carrier MSCU.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShipsGo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shipsgo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipsgo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipsgo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shipsgo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shipsgo_list_ocean_carriers
tools.title: List ocean carriers
tools.description: List the ocean carriers ShipsGo supports, with their SCAC codes and status. Use the codes in ocean shipment tools. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/carriers.

filters.description: Filters as field → 'operator:value' pairs, for example { "status": "in:NEW,BOOKED" }. Operators: eq, not_eq, in, not_in, contains, not_contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, between. Fields include status, carrier, container_number, booking_number, reference, port_of_loading, date_of_loading.

tools.name: shipsgo_list_ocean_shipments
tools.title: List ocean shipments
tools.description: List ocean container shipments on the account with status, carrier, route and dates. Filter by status, carrier, reference or container number. A sub-account with the Co-Worker role sees only its own shipments. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments.

filters.description: Filters as field → 'operator:value' pairs, for example { "status": "in:NEW,BOOKED" }. Operators: eq, not_eq, in, not_in, contains, not_contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, between. Fields include status, carrier, container_number, booking_number, reference, port_of_loading, date_of_loading.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_ocean_shipment
tools.title: Get an ocean shipment
tools.description: Get one ocean shipment with its status, containers, carrier and movement events. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

shipment_id.description: Shipment id, from a list or create tool.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_ocean_route
tools.title: Get an ocean shipment route
tools.description: Get the route of one ocean shipment as GeoJSON (ports and track points). ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}/geojson.

shipment_id.description: Shipment id, from a list or create tool.

tools.name: shipsgo_create_ocean_shipment
tools.title: Create an ocean shipment
tools.description: Start tracking an ocean shipment by booking number or container number. Creating a shipment uses account credits (HTTP 402 when none are left). A repeat with the same reference and booking number (or container number when no booking number is given) returns HTTP 409 with the existing shipment, at no cost. ShipsGo API: POST /v2/ocean/shipments.

reference.description: Your own reference, 5 to 128 characters. It is also the default title of tracking emails.

carrier.description: Carrier SCAC code, for example MSCU. List codes with shipsgo_list_ocean_carriers.

booking_number.description: Ocean booking number, for example MEDUQY000000.

tools.name: shipsgo_update_ocean_shipment
tools.title: Update an ocean shipment
tools.description: Change the reference of an ocean shipment. Only the reference can be changed here. ShipsGo API: PATCH /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

shipment_id.description: Shipment id, from a list or create tool.

reference.description: The new reference for the shipment.

tools.name: shipsgo_delete_ocean_shipment
tools.title: Delete an ocean shipment
tools.description: Delete an ocean shipment from the account. Tracking stops and the shipment cannot be restored by this server. ShipsGo API: DELETE /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

shipment_id.description: Shipment id, from a list or create tool.
